name: greek_woman_480bc

peplos.material: caban wool scan, saffron (0.45,0.30,0.10) + woad border
peplos.notes: body + overfold, 2 pins per shoulder, open sides (armholes), A-line skirt, belt over the overfold

veil.notes: mantle drawn over the head, pinned on the crown, floats over the hair

design_source: Peplos Kore (Acropolis 679, c. 530 BC), Olympia west pediment women, Athena on Attic red-figure vases; long dress pins: Herodotus 5.87-88; veiled women: white-ground lekythoi, Hegeso stele
licence: our own code (Blender cloth simulation); scanned fabrics CC0 Poly Haven (rough_linen, caban, hessian_230); MakeHuman body CC0

self_rating.notes: peplos: armholes, A-line skirt, hands outside, woad hem, belt, sandals, earrings (look 83). Veil over the head works but sat in a peak above the crown and was stiff (fixed in code: lower crown pin, softer wool; not yet re-rendered). Overfold flares a little at the arms. Dress pins too small to read at full shot.
